baselineValue.format: npm run format:eslint && npm run format:prettier && npm run format:py && npm run format:keep-sorted
baselineValue.format:py: (command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff check --fix . && ruff format .) || (pipenv run ruff check --fix . && pipenv run ruff format .)
baselineValue.rdb-e2e: rdb stream -new -realm chromium:public -- npm run e2e
baselineValue.rdb-unit: rdb stream -new -realm chromium:public -- npm run unit
baselineValue.test: npm run unit && npm run e2e && npm run wpt

candidateValue.format: npm run format:eslint && npm run format:prettier && npm run format:py && npm run format:keep-sorted
candidateValue.format:py: (command -v ruff_chromium >/dev/null && ruff_chromium check --fix . && ruff_chromium format .) || (PATH="../../third_party/depot_tools:$PATH" ruff_chromium check --fix . && PATH="../../third_party/depot_tools:$PATH" ruff_chromium format .)
candidateValue.rdb-e2e: rdb stream -new -realm chromium:public -- npm run e2e
candidateValue.rdb-unit: rdb stream -new -realm chromium:public -- npm run unit
candidateValue.test: npm run unit && npm run e2e

baselineValue.bump:beta: pnpm version "v$(pnpm pkg get version | jq -r)-beta.$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"
baselineValue.pub:beta: pnpm bump:beta && pnpm publish --tag next --publish-branch v4 --no-git-checks --dry-run
